name: Barbell Bench Press
description: The classic upper-body press: lying on a bench, lower the bar to your chest with control, then press it back up to straight arms.

source.title: Chest Press (ACE Exercise Library)
source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Lie on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and lift it off the rack to straight arms over your shoulders.
cues: Keep your shoulder blades squeezed together and your feet planted.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, elbows at roughly 45° to your body, not flared straight out.
Press back up over your shoulders.
Use a spotter or a rack with safety bars, and learn with light weight first.

prescription.note: Warm up with lighter sets first. Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Arms straight
keyframes.cue: Bar over your shoulders, arms straight.

keyframes.name: Lower to your chest
keyframes.cue: Bend your elbows and lower the bar to your chest.
